evidence.title: Runner README
evidence.locator: Features; Also included; Supported agents; License
evidence.finding: Native macOS/Windows (Linux beta) app where Claude Code, Codex, Antigravity, Copilot CLI, pi and others run in real terminals; reusable crews and missions with a shared feed; runner CLI; remote control private beta; MIT.

evidence.title: Runner LICENSE
evidence.locator: MIT License text
evidence.finding: MIT, copyright 2026 Yicheng Wang; README notes versions released 2026-08-22 to 2026-09-22 were GPL-3.0-only.

evidence.title: Workspace Cargo.toml
evidence.locator: workspace package version
evidence.finding: Rust workspace version 0.20.0 with crates runner-app, runner-cli, runner-core, runner-daemon, runner-terminal; vendored dependencies under vendor/.

evidence.title: Install Runner
evidence.locator: Download the app table; Set up an agent
evidence.finding: macOS 12+, Windows 10 1809+ x64, Linux beta (glibc 2.35+, ARM64 and x86_64); agent CLIs provide their own model connection and accounts; first-run Setup detects agents.

evidence.title: Supported agents
evidence.locator: Install and sign in; Capabilities; Launch options
evidence.finding: Codex, Claude Code, Antigravity CLI, pi, Copilot CLI, Cursor, Grok Build, OpenCode v2 and opt-in TRAE; separately installed CLIs keep native TUI; per-agent capability table; Bypass defaults off for chats; missions use broad access.

evidence.title: CLI reference
evidence.locator: Command overview
evidence.finding: runner commands: remote, daemon, status, project, role, crew, mission (start, stop, resume, feed, answer, link), chat start, session (list, stop, resume, restart), msg; --json output; works with app closed.

evidence.title: Drive Runner from agents
evidence.locator: Discover the installed version; Start and follow a crew
evidence.finding: Installs a Runner skill for detected agents so an agent can start missions, follow the feed and message members; missions started from a chat link back and report.

evidence.title: Missions
evidence.locator: Goal and membership; Feed; Linked chat and reports; Permissions; Stop, resume and archive
evidence.finding: Mission = goal, per-member terminals, persistent feed; states Needs you/Failed/Interrupted/Working/Settled/Ended; shared directory, no branches or worktrees; mission launches use broad-access permissions; stop, resume, restart slot, archive.

evidence.title: Crews
evidence.locator: Slots; Team conventions
evidence.finding: Reusable teams of role slots with unique handles, per-slot agent/model/effort overrides and shared team conventions; starter Pair coding crew.

evidence.title: Sessions
evidence.locator: Read the state; Choose the right action
evidence.finding: A session is one agent or shell in a real terminal; hooks or terminal activity report state; stop, resume, restart actions.

evidence.title: Chats and windows
evidence.locator: Files view; Changes; Notifications
evidence.finding: Side panel Files with git status and worktree picker, read-only Changes view with per-file diffs and mark-viewed, desktop notifications, split tabs and windows.

evidence.title: Remote access
evidence.locator: Sign in; Through Runner relay; PIN pairing
evidence.finding: Private beta, invite-only, mainland China; hosted relay with end-to-end encrypted sessions and PIN pairing; signed-out Runner works locally only; remote access never stops sessions.

evidence.title: Claude Code accounts
evidence.locator: Add an account; Switch the active account
evidence.finding: Multiple Claude Code sign-ins in separate config folders with a usage popover showing weekly usage.

evidence.title: MCP servers and skills
evidence.locator: MCP servers; Skills
evidence.finding: Settings pages list and toggle each agent own MCP servers and skills, editing the native config for new sessions.

evidence.title: Build a crew
evidence.locator: working directories note
evidence.finding: Runner does not isolate working directories automatically; create a Git worktree before launch if needed.

evidence.title: First mission
evidence.locator: directory note
evidence.finding: Runner starts the crew in the directory given and does not create an isolated copy or Git worktree.

evidence.title: Architecture
evidence.locator: Overview; usage module; agent updates; mission inbox
evidence.finding: Three-process model: GPUI app, runnerd daemon (SQLite, session manager, event bus) and runner CLI over runnerd.sock; sessions survive app quit; usage module reads Claude Code, Codex and Antigravity limits; Claude/Codex update checks disabled inside sessions.

evidence.title: Process model
evidence.locator: runnerd lifecycle
evidence.finding: Daemon keeps running without clients; Ask/Keep/Stop on app quit; app crash leaves daemon sessions running; daemon crash closes PTYs on macOS and kills sessions.

evidence.title: runnersh.dev home page
evidence.locator: banner
evidence.finding: Site banner: Runner for iPhone and remote access are in private beta with an iPhone waitlist; links to Docs and Release notes; no pricing page (404).

evidence.title: Runner downloads
evidence.locator: platform list
evidence.finding: Download page for macOS (arm64, x64), Windows x64 and Linux packages.

evidence.title: Runner Linux packages and optional runnerd user service
evidence.locator: Optional systemd user service (lines 92-107); docs/guide/guides/troubleshooting.md Linux local builds (line 76); packaging/linux/runnerd.service
evidence.finding: Linux packages ship runner, runnerd and runner-app plus an optional systemd user service for runnerd; troubleshooting says that if the CLI is used over SSH, start runnerd with systemctl --user first. This documents running the daemon and CLI on a Linux host reached over SSH, but no guide presents remote or server execution as a supported workflow.
